issues.description: The problem statement (UML and task text) implies the Farm's animals attribute is encapsulated (private) and students are instructed to provide a getter and setter. In the provided solution, the animals attribute is declared public (public List<Animal> animals;). This visibility mismatch could confuse students about expected encapsulation and field access (and may conflict with tests or grading that assume a private field with accessor methods).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the animals field private in the solution (private List<Animal> animals;) and rely on the public getter and setter for external access, aligning the implementation with the UML/task description and preserving encapsulation.
